judged_text: Jobs::PollFeed's core feed-to-topic pipeline has zero behavioral coverage: the spec stubs poll_feed itself, so SimpleRSS parsing, the link fallback, CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub), the missing-user early return, and the handoff to TopicEmbed.import are never executed, and no test anywhere verifies a feed item produces a topic/post. This untested path hides a latent crash: i.content.scrub (poll_feed.rb:35) raises NoMethodError on feeds/items lacking a content element (common in plain RSS 2.0 feeds with only <description>), and since the job is sidekiq_options retry: false, it dies silently every hour.

adjudication.rationale: In app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb the job unconditionally does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` inside `rss.items.each`. If a feed item lacks a `content` field (e.g., RSS items with only `description`), `i.content` can be nil and `nil.scrub` will raise `NoMethodError`, causing the scheduled job to fail. The spec (spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb) only asserts execute-gating and never exercises `poll_feed`, so this failure mode isn’t covered anywhere in the diff.
